source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag CCU Top-Load Dryer Service Data Sheet
source.extractedTextFile: backend/docs/manuals/WPL Top load Dryer Service Manual-extracted.txt

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered. Use Diagnostics Home or Component Activation as needed, then continue below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Myst valve activation
steps.body: Service Diagnostics → Component Activation → Myst Valve. Verify spray into drum.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Diagnostics → Component Activation → Myst Valve. Verify spray into drum.

steps.title: Verify water supply
steps.body: Confirm fill hose connected and household water on.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Confirm fill hose connected and household water on.

steps.title: P8-1 myst valve wire
steps.body: Red wire from water valve connected to CCU P8-1 per wiring diagram.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Red wire from water valve connected to CCU P8-1 per wiring diagram.

steps.title: Myst valve coil P8-1 to P9-2
steps.body: Power off. Coil resistance 510–590 Ω. Open → check harness then replace valve.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Coil resistance 510–590 Ω. Open → check harness then replace valve.

testPoint.label: Myst valve coil P8-1 to P9-2

images.caption: Strip circuits — motor, heater, thermistors, myst valve (page 22)

steps.title: Myst nozzle
steps.body: Inside drum: unscrew/replace myst nozzle with 7/16 in wrench if plugged; retest.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inside drum: unscrew/replace myst nozzle with 7/16 in wrench if plugged; retest.

steps.title: Valve plumbing
steps.body: Remove back panel — verify hose and wires at myst valve assembly.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove back panel — verify hose and wires at myst valve assembly.

steps.title: Repair harness
steps.oemOutcome: Repair myst valve wiring to P8-1.

steps.title: Replace CCU
steps.oemOutcome: Replace CCU when valve and plumbing OK but no spray.

steps.title: Myst valve verified
steps.oemOutcome: Valve coil and spray path OK.
